description: Use when an agent integrates tokenized equities on Robinhood Chain (4663). Input: optional symbols (<=20), address, limit (1-100), feedOnly. Output: JSON per token: on-chain uid/symbol checked against the public registry, uiMultiplier vs registry, pending multiplier, paused, supply, Chainlink feed age/stale/lag, reference total-return value; US 24/5 session state. Reference signals, not market data or advice. Example: ?symbols=AAPL,TSLA Price: $0.003 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: One token contract; not in the registry → 404 (not charged)

feedOnly.description: true = only tokens with a Chainlink feed

symbols.description: Comma list of up to 20 tickers (AAPL,TSLA). Default: all, alphabetical

name: rh_stock_tokens
title: Robinhood Chain stock tokens: registry verification, share multiplier, Chainlink feed health, 24/5 market state
